summary: This round's source change is correct: each stack's control-plane runtime now gets read access to the shared `halo-control-plane-integration-credential-key`, and the Cloud Run service depends on that grant. A temp test checks the grant for both `west` and `prod`, and every changed line is covered. The change cannot be approved because `releases/.tmp-tests/promoteRelease.test.mjs` is back in the temp run, and all 10 of its tests fail.

findings.body: The temp test run fails again. `releases/.tmp-tests/promoteRelease.test.mjs` is back in this change's temp run, and all 10 tests fail with ENOENT at line 43 (`promoteFixture`) when copying `releases/promotion.mjs`. That file and the `pnpm promote` feature are not in this branch. The round 3 reply said these tests belong to PR 422. While the file is present in this worktree, it still runs and fails the gate. Remove `releases/.tmp-tests/promoteRelease.test.mjs` from this branch's worktree, or keep it only where PR 422's `releases/promotion.mjs` exists. The other suites pass: electron 4/4, infra 7/7, and config 11/11.
